Indications for Use (Describe)
Phasor EVAC-MRI is indicated when access to and evacuation of a cranial subacute or chronic hematoma or hygroma is
necessary. The Phasor EVAC-MRI system is intended for drainage of subdural fluid accumulations such as hygromas and
chronic or subacute hematomas to an external suction reservoir. The Phasor EVAC–MRI system is also intended
for draining air and fluids from the subdural space immediately following craniotomy procedures performed to remove a
chronic or subacute subdural hematoma.
